copy.curiosityHook: As memory and delusion begin to blur within the halfway house, what truth is waiting inside the childhood events he cannot stop revisiting?
copy.description: After moving into a halfway house, a mentally fragile man begins to slip back into an internal world shaped by his illness, meticulously reliving an unresolved chapter of his childhood.
copy.vibeSummary: Slow, somber, and deeply suspenseful. A demanding solo watch focused on an unraveling interior world.
copy.whyWatch: Directed by David Cronenberg, this deliberate psychological thriller swaps sudden shocks for quiet, methodical tension and heavy emotional depth.

allowedMaterial: A mentally disturbed man moving into a halfway house
Protagonist gradually slipping into an illness-created inner realm
Replaying a key part of his childhood
excludedMaterial: Outcomes of his illness or residency
Specific crimes, identities, or culpability details
